The eight-term join cycle z is closed and not a boundary; independent coordinate computation and full checking of the actual 60-term certificate from certificate.json prove ∂w=τz+z on all 600 oriented triangles. Row and column generators send z to -z exactly, and group conjugacy gives the product-sign factors. Shareshian–Wachs / Jonsson independently prove integral H2=Z/3, and the H1=0 connectivity premise makes integral to mod-3 reduction injective. Thus tau acts -1 integrally. Barycentric subdivision removes inversions, and exactness of C2 coinvariants over F3 yields H2(ordinary quotient;F3)=0. Only this board and degree are proved; finite check is exhaustive for the finite complex, not a result for all board sizes.
